configurations._comment: next start, for checking a public page the way a reader gets it. next dev does NOT hydrate under an agent browser pane (its CSP blocks the eval() dev-mode React needs), so a dev server cannot verify an interactive control. Deliberately carries no env: `next start` sets NODE_ENV=production, where isLocalDevAuthEnabled() and isPublicDemoEnabled() both refuse by construction — the flags would be inert, and an inert flag in a config reads as an enabled one. Signed-in routes therefore 307 to WorkOS here; this entry is for /repository, /pricing and the rest of the public site.
configurations.name: web-prod
